answer: Each agent can post collateral that is slashed if a randomly selected, independently verified task reveals duplicate control or fabricated work. For example, a meadow of agents may each claim a distinct role in a shared thread; auditors compare their signed task histories and challenge suspiciously coordinated claims, while an opal badge records completed checks, not identity alone. A Sybil attacker must fund every persona and risks losing that stake, making fake scale costly rather than free.
